params.name: action
params.description: Service action name. Must take the string value ```create```.

params.name: signature
params.description: Hash of params (Cf. [Signature hash protocol](/developer-guide/v3/get-access/sign-your-requests)).

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client

params.name: nonce
params.description: A random token used to prevent replay attacks (Cf. [Signature v2 - Getnonce](#operation/signaturev2-getnonce))

params.name: iconids
params.description: Ids of the Nudge Icon

params.name: content
params.description: Array with 2 lines of text representing the Nudge text content

params.name: model
params.description: Model integer value of a device or a consumable

params.name: position
params.description: Nudge position in the dynamic screen list. Allowed values are ```first``` and ```last```.
